epic.name: File log
unverifiedAssumptions: Verify the newest file is at the top on first load: the app sorts by received time itself, but if the service returns a different order or limits the page size, an older file could appear above a newer one.

Verify the finished/failed notice appears: the app assumes a file's status in the file list changes from Processing to Imported or Failed as the import runs. If the service only updates the status later, the notice won't appear even though the import worked.
The live service holds only 4 files, so loading everything at once was tested at that volume only. Confirm File log still shows every file when there are many.
The paging controls sit in the table card's footer next to the source note, because the design has no paging. Check this placement looks right.

Filter labels (Status, Curve family, Received from, Received to) sit above each control in a row above the table; the design's single status filter had no visible label. Check this layout looks right.
Sorting a column keeps you on the current page; changing a filter goes back to page 1. Check this is what you want.

New wording not in the design: a failed download reads 'The original file could not be downloaded.' then the service's message and 'Choose Retry to try again.'; the missing-file screen links back with 'Back to the file list'. Check this wording.
